name: UNFI - Sarasota North DC, Sarasota FL

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocoded the WRONG building. roster lat/lng 27.264831,-82.484075 / address 6272 McIntosh Rd is UNFI's OLD ~734k sq ft Sarasota DC (Sarasota County). The roster facility NAME explicitly is the new 'Sarasota North DC' / '1M sq ft automated DC opened FY26 (KNAPP robotics)'. That facility is at 8380 21st Street East, in the SRQ Logistics Center on the Manatee-Sarasota county line, east of Sarasota-Bradenton International Airport (KSRQ), near University Pkwy/US-301 and I-75. Resolved coordinates ~27.3935,-82.5418.
fieldNotes.imageryState: Best available Maxar satellite imagery of the SRQ Logistics Center parcel shows the UNFI building MID-CONSTRUCTION: shell roofed, but surrounding yard is bare earth, parking unstriped, dock doors and gate not yet installed/visible. Facility opened Sept 2025. Street View on 21st St E is 2019/2022, pre-build. Yard-configuration fields therefore could not be observed and are estimated from the building footprint plus UNFI's published spec for comparable new-build DCs.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 50+ band. 1M sq ft modern cross-dock-style food DC; comparable UNFI new build (Manchester PA) has 214 dock positions. Not directly counted — imagery pre-dates dock installation.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Estimated. Comparable UNFI Manchester new build has 492 trailer parking spaces; Sarasota North footprint supports a large trailer yard. Not directly counted.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Assumed true — modern 1M sq ft automated grocery DC with KNAPP robotics, on a master-planned logistics-park parcel; perimeter control is standard. Not observed in imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Assumed false / remoteGs true — current-generation new builds typically use kiosk/app gate check-in rather than a staffed booth. Low confidence; not observed.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs N-S immediately along the WEST side of the parcel. No spur observed entering the property in construction-era imagery; the DC is a truck-served grocery DC. Marked false but flagged — verify if a spur is added.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~95 acres estimated for the UNFI parcel within the 300-acre SRQ Logistics Center master plan; the perimeter box is approximate.

citations.claim: UNFI's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties, lists a distribution centre at "Sarasota North, Florida" as of 2025-08-02. Our roster address for this record is "6272 McIntosh Rd, Sarasota, FL 34238".

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

sources.covers: UNFI network optimisation, the Allentown PA closure, and Central-region consolidations

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Sarasota North, Florida as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
